item: 0813 item 4 / 0826 item 4c: RUNBOOK c2v007 roster builder (cross-family)
reviewer_lane: Claude3 (helper lens; the lead re-read _ceiling_or_hold L4763-4790 from bytes)
context_answer: c2v007 does not have P112's Phase-1-ceiling defect. It never stops or launches anything, and it calls only read-only P112 functions (history, calls, registered_entry, assemble_registry verify=True), never next_attempt, fresh_launch_plan or _commit_plan_check. The Phase-1 ceiling only filters Phase-1 evidence (PHASE1_RECEIPT_AFTER_CEILING L4816-4817 under PHASE_1 only). Phase-2 builds accept attempts and reruns after 2026-11-06T05:59Z (helper probes, TESTED).

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: c2v007 is pinned to P112 cx2v004 only
findings.evidence: P112_REVIEWED_SHA 8cec1b56 (L3639) and the REGISTRY_VERIFIER_PIN refusal (L3648); snapshot capture and verify run the cx2v004 Context (config schema P112_CONFIG_CX2V004, TOOL_PIN P112_LAUNCHER_CX2V004). Resolved downstream: under 0835 the cw8 v002 roster builder (a2d8dc00) pins only the v002 launcher and drops cx2v004.

findings.class: NOTE (A249 item 2/4 integrity depends on root procedure)
findings.label: FORMAL + TESTED; lead re-read
findings.title: An unclassified HELD_FOR_CAUSE pair is closed at the ceiling as SCHEDULE_CEILING (UNEVALUATED)
findings.evidence: _ceiling_or_hold (L4763-4782) returns a present closure before any hold check; the cause producer may be null (L4606, L4620); phase1_snapshot does not require cause rows for eligible FAILED attempts. Probe P10 and suite case ceiling_time_is_boundary: two identical solo CHILD_FAILED|ROUTE_A_NO_FIXED_POINT attempts with no causes become SCHEDULE_CEILING. So the guard holds only if root runs the cause producer before the snapshot. The cw8 v002 roster builder keeps this function unchanged, so it inherits the same ordering.
findings.recommendation: A precondition before the snapshot: every eligible solo FAILED attempt has a bound cause row; refuse otherwise. Apply it to the cw8 v002 roster builder, the adopted line.

findings.label: FORMAL + TESTED
findings.title: check_cutoff checks a record's own T only for successors
findings.evidence: L3573-3618 compares T with the derived T only for successors (L3601-3607); a probe accepted first records with wrong T values. Builder outputs use the derived T, and honest producers (snapshot L5736-5742, P112 write_cutoff) write the correct T.

findings.label: FORMAL + TESTED
findings.title: Phase-1 closures are accepted outside snapshot mode
findings.evidence: Exact attempt-list binding applies only in P112_SAVED_PHASE1_SNAPSHOT mode (L4955, L4789-4791). In legacy READ_ONLY_VERIFY mode, a truncated list plus a matching closure gives SCHEDULE_CEILING. Phase 2 has the same exposure.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: Phase-2 interface limits (refusals, not wrong records)
findings.evidence: A zero-attempt Phase-2 call refuses CALL_ATTEMPTS_REQUIRED (L4793-4794); Phase-2 registry verify accepts only P112 entries (L3764); there is no Phase-2 after-ceiling receipt exclusion.

findings.label: TESTED
findings.title: Test coverage gaps
findings.evidence: The release synthetic clocks start 2026-01-01, so no release case puts Phase-2 attempts after the Phase-1 ceiling (the helper's probes P1-P4 cover this). There is no end-to-end snapshot-to-FULL test; the README discloses the seam.
